name: Weather Timeline Lite
description:
See the next 12 hours as a weather timeline built for the wide XENEON Edge display.

• Follow temperature, conditions, rain chance, a precise NOW marker, and day/night changes hour by hour.
• See sunrise and sunset where they actually happen on the timeline.
• Keep the last successful forecast visible with a clear stale state if a refresh fails.
• Choose four themes and use tuned layouts for every XENEON Edge slot size and orientation.

Setup: choose your location and preferences in iCUE. Units can follow iCUE automatically. Weather access uses iCUE when available; if your iCUE build does not provide it, you can add your own free WeatherAPI.com key as a local fallback.

Lite is free and keeps the complete 12-hour experience. Pro extends the view to 24 hours and adds deeper hour details, saved locations, more themes, and additional solar context.

Compatibility: CORSAIR XENEON Edge.

Made by PackRat.
release_notes: Initial free release. 12 hour weather timeline, current conditions, hourly temperature and condition icons, precipitation probability, daily high and low, iCUE-aware units, selected location, sunrise and sunset markers, cached stale-data fallback, four themes, touch hour detail, and all eight XENEON Edge layouts.
